subject.title: fix(tui): prevent cross-session leaks and lost streamed replies

question: Should this protected, follow-on TUI session-state refactor be prepared against current `main` and landed after its current-merge lint and focused Gateway/PTy evidence are confirmed?
rationale: The change rewrites a central terminal transcript and session-ownership path shortly after a related merged fix; the `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the supplied check state does not establish the exact current-merge result.

options.title: Prepare and validate current merge result
options.body: Rebase or use the native prepare flow, resolve `check-lint`, and confirm the session-isolation and real Gateway PTY scenarios on the resulting merge candidate.

options.title: Pause for narrower follow-up
options.body: Keep the prior merged synchronization fix and split any remaining case-sensitivity or lifecycle corrections into smaller independently reviewable PRs.

recommendation.title: Prepare and validate current merge result
recommendation.body: Rebase or use the native prepare flow, resolve `check-lint`, and confirm the session-isolation and real Gateway PTY scenarios on the resulting merge candidate.
